feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. It reverts kp to 4.0 and base_speed to 1.5, the iteration 1 values that scored 574, the best so far. Iteration 2 (kp 4.5, base 1.4, score 477) lost oval and s-bend completion, and its steering_oscillation rose to 0.34 to 0.39, so the kp increase is the likely cause. The candidate keeps the iteration 1 sensor array (x = -0.03 to +0.03 m, 16 mm footprints) and line_loss last_direction. It adds two changes: kd 0.8 to 1.0, to damp the slalom overshoot and oscillation, and mass 0.8 to 0.6 kg, to reduce yaw inertia for the sharp slalom bends. Both are small single-variable moves from the best measured design, so the race will isolate their effect. Note that mass and kd are changed together, so if the result moves, the telemetry may not show which one caused it. Plan the next revision from the race as follows. If the slalom still ends off track with max_error above 0.06 and line_loss_events are not falling, try a larger kd step (to 1.2) before touching kp. If oval or s-bend completion drops below the iteration 1 rates (0.8 and 0.65), or steering_oscillation rises above about 0.35, return kd to 0.8 and keep the mass change. If the mass change looks harmful, return mass to 0.8 and keep kd. Approving now is right for this mid-run exploration iteration: the candidate is valid, close to the best design, and each change is tied to a measured failure.
requested_changes: If slalom still ends off track with max_error above 0.06 and line_loss_events do not fall, raise controller.kd from 1.0 to about 1.2 before changing kp. Basis: iteration 1 slalom max_error was 0.0635 and steering_oscillation was 0.257, so damping is the next untested lever.

If oval or s-bend completion falls below the iteration 1 rates (0.8 and 0.65), or steering_oscillation rises above about 0.35, return controller.kd to 0.8 and keep geometry.mass at 0.6. Basis: iteration 2 showed steering_oscillation of 0.34 to 0.39 and lost completions when the controller was pushed harder.
If the mass change looks harmful, return geometry.mass to 0.8 and keep kd at 1.0. Basis: mass and kd are changed together here, so a regression should be isolated before the next change.
